sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel away to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach's recent form shows a dip after an excellent run, with their last five results reading loss, win, draw, win, win. Alsager Town remain rooted to the bottom with just 4 points, so this presents a strong opportunity for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host bottom-club Widnes Town (Saturday 15:00), looking to bounce back after their own recent loss and close the 2-point gap to leaders Sandbach. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall (Saturday 15:00) in a mid-table clash; Eccleshall have won their last game and sit fifth, while Bridgnorth themselves have recently lost back-to-back matches. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community (Saturday 15:00 and again Wednesday 19:45 in Brereton's fixture list), with both sides showing mixed recent form. Bilston Town (5th) host Foley Meir (Saturday 15:00) in a relatively tight fixture between mid-table sides. Barnton travel to Shawbury United (Saturday 15:00); Shawbury are in worrying form with six consecutive losses and occupy 15th place, while Barnton have won their last two. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town (Saturday 15:00), a fixture between sides separated by just two points in mid-table. Crewe host Allscott Heath (Saturday 15:00); both sides sit in the lower half but Allscott enter with three wins in their last five. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (Saturday 15:00), a bottom-half encounter between teams with poor recent records. Brereton Social host Widnes Town (Saturday 15:00), then face Wednesfield Community at home on Wednesday 19:45, giving them two fixtures this week as they seek to climb away from the lower reaches of the table.
